note: What a server sends to show a spell's targeter on the client's own champion. The header names the champion.

fields.name: slot
fields.note: Which slot's spell, from 0 to 63. A client does nothing for any other value.

fields.name: time
fields.note: How long the targeter shows, in seconds. Zero or less does nothing.

revisions.note: A client acts on its own champion whatever the header names, and ignores the message while a targeter is already showing.
